about_the_game:
Idle Pixels is a complex idle clicker game with almost infinite possibilities. Slay pixel monsters to earn money and experience. Level up, gain prestige points, and unlock powerful abilities. Fight bosses, conquer various worlds, and use every opportunity to become stronger!

GAMEPLAY

Click or use idle damage to defeat enemies. Farm gold and other currencies to purchase hundreds of upgrades

PERMANENT UPGRADES

Invest in powerful prestige upgrades, which can also be permanently enhanced using tiers. Each upgrade requires a reset of your game progress, but it's a fair price for the bonuses you receive!

PERKS AND POWER-UPS

Complete different in-game goals to unlock permanent power-ups. Just keep playing and grow stronger over time!

ENEMIES AND BOSSES

Battle against hundreds of different pixel enemies. Each one has a super-powerful boss version that must be defeated to complete the world.

WORLDS AND COMPLETION

Defeat all enemies and bosses to unlock new worlds. Earn incredible rewards for achieving every goal!

PASSIVE INCOME

Use an interest system to earn currencies even without fighting. Deposit and withdraw each currency for receiving steady profits over time.

CURRENCY EXCHANGE

Manage your capital by freely converting one currency into another. No need to farm endlessly — exchange anytime!

BETS AND REWARDS

Do you have very little money or an excess of it? Try your luck in the lottery! You could either lose everything or walk away with a pile of cash.

ACHIEVEMENTS

Find and unlock all 100 Steam achievements — a real challenge for the most hardcore players!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 Dual Core
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTS 450 / AMD Radeon HD 5570
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 - i7 Quad Core
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 750Ti / AMD Radeon R9 270x
  • Storage: 150 MB available space
